text: 埃泰克公告，拟以不低于人民币3000万元（含）、不超过人民币5000万元（含）回购公司股份，回购价格不超过48.57元/股（含），回购股份拟用于股权激励或员工持股计划。按回购价格上限测算，预计回购股份数量61.77万股~102.94万股，占总股本比例0.34%~0.57%。回购期限为自董事会审议通过回购方案之日起12个月内，资金来源为公司自有资金或自筹资金。
text_en: ETEC announced that it plans to repurchase company shares for no less than 30 million yuan (inclusive) and no more than 50 million yuan (inclusive), at a repurchase price of no more than 48.57 yuan per share (inclusive), with the repurchased shares intended for equity incentives or employee stock ownership plans. Based on the upper limit of the repurchase price, the expected number of shares to be repurchased is 617,700 to 1,029,400 shares, accounting for 0.34% to 0.57% of total share capital. The repurchase period is within 12 months from the date the board of directors approves the repurchase plan, and the source of funds is the company's own funds or self-raised funds.
